attempted_claim: Let d>=2 and let p be a degree-d parabolic polynomial with non-totally-disconnected Julia set, neither conjugate to z->z^d nor to a Chebyshev polynomial (of the same type used in the Astorg-Buff-Dujardin-Peters-Raissy parabolic-implosion construction, so Sk(p,d) admits maps with wandering Fatou components). Let U_d={(p(z), w^d+a(z)): a in C_d[z]} be the unicritical subfamily of Sk(p,d), with vertical bifurcation current T_{bif,U_d}=dd^c L_v and bifurcation measure mu_{bif,U_d}=T_{bif,U_d}^{d+1}. Does Supp T_{bif,U_d}=Supp T_{bif,U_d}^k for all 1<=k<=d+1, does Supp mu_{bif,U_d} have non-empty interior in U_d, and is dim_H Supp mu_{bif,U_d}=2(d+1) at every point of its support?
decisive_failure: The exit rests on heuristic codimension counting and a bounded escape-region estimate rather than a proved strict-filtration theorem: full rigor would require a parabolic-base transversality lemma for Misiurewicz hypersurfaces and Holder-potential estimates at boundary support points, which were unavailable in-session. No literature search was consumed.
